title: Gakkou no Kowai Uwasa: Hanako-san ga Kita!!
native_title: 学校のコワイうわさ 花子さんがきた！！
overview:
Have you ever heard of "Hanako-san"? They say that if you make a call from the phone box at the edge of town, a ghost called "Hanako-san" appears. That's the rumor.

"There's no way that's true." You might say so. But is that really so?

There are lots of mysterious things in this world that you don't know about...

Based on the animated series of school ghost stories, this interactive movie follows three fifth-graders whose prank call from a phone box sets evil spirits loose. To close the gate between the spirit world and ours, they must gather seven mirror fragments hidden around the school before 5:00 in the morning.

Explore the school floor by floor, talk to the people and spirits you meet and pick up items, with Hanako-san stepping in to protect you from the ghosts. Each chapter ends with a minigame to seal away a ghost. Animated episodes found during play can be watched in the school's audiovisual room.

みなさんは「花子さん」ってきいたことがありますか？町はずれの電話ボックスから電話をかけると「花子さん」という幽霊があらわれる、そんなうわさなんです。

「そんなことあるわけないよ」みなさんはそう言うかもしれませんね。ほんとうにそうでしょうか？

この世にはみなさんの知らない不思議なことがたくさんあるんですよ…
